<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that letters to joint policyholders show only one name, often the wrong one. I checked the five most similar items: activity timeline display (completed, unrelated), claim information display (in progress, unrelated), document classifier confidence threshold (unstarted, unrelated), policyholder milestone notifications (roadmap, unrelated), and bulk upload documents (completed, unrelated). None address joint policyholder name display in letters, and all similarity scores are very low. The core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
